# App map (generated by `npm run map`, do not edit by hand)

The state shape, every command with its integration scope, and every HTTP path, read from the code. A
test (`apps/server/test/app-map.test.ts`) fails when this is stale. Search it for a name rather than
reading it whole. `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` explains how the pieces fit together.

- API version `1` · realtime protocol `1`
- 16 GameState fields · 173 commands · 350 HTTP paths

## GameState shape

Top-level fields of the authoritative `GameState` (`packages/domain` `GameStateSchema`), the
single JSON blob the server persists and projects per role.

- `actors`
- `builderPolicy`
- `combat`
- `crafting`
- `definitions`
- `heldDamage`
- `heldRolls`
- `partyVisibility`
- `pendingImports`
- `rest`
- `revision`
- `rollCalls`
- `rolls`
- `rulesPolicy`
- `schemaVersion`
- `stagingDefaults`

## Commands

The mutation surface shared by both transports (Socket.IO + HTTP `/api/v1`); each requires the
listed integration scope. Adding one: its typed socket event in domain `ClientToServerEvents`, its
schema in `packages/domain/src/commands.ts`, its route and scope in `GAME_COMMANDS` (`packages/api-contract`), and
one table entry under `apps/server/src/commands/`. Both transports register from that table, and
the OpenAPI document generates the command's operation from it. Then the projection decision.

Namespaces: `action`, `actor`, `annotation`, `builder`, `character`, `check`, `crafting`, `damage`, `death-save`, `dice`, `door`, `effect`, `encounter`, `fog`, `initiative`, `item`, `light`, `object`, `reaction`, `replay`, `rest`, `roll-call`, `rules`, `save`, `scene`, `sound`, `spell-zone`, `summon`, `survival`, `table`, `terrain`, `time`, `token`, `turn`, `vision`, `wall`.
